name: know-my-meals
description: Read your Know My Meals food log: calories and macros by day, week or month, eating patterns, top foods, today's remaining targets and the raw meal list. Read-only.

interface.longDescription:
Know My Meals is a voice-first food log. Connect it to see your own meals in the chat: how your week went against your targets, whether you eat more on weekends or late at night, which foods bring in most of your protein or calories, and what's left for today. It can also give ChatGPT the raw meal list, for charts and spreadsheets.

It's read-only. It can see your meals, ingredients, daily targets and plan details. It can't change your log, and it can't see your coach chat, voice recordings or payment details.

Sign in with your Know My Meals account when you connect. Values are AI estimates the user has confirmed in the app; it isn't medical advice.
defaultPrompt: How did my calories and protein go this week?
Do I eat more on weekends?
Where does most of my protein come from?

positive.prompt: How did my calories and protein go this week compared with my targets?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports per-day or average calories and protein for the current week against the account's targets (1,920 kcal, 127 g protein), says how many days were logged and how many hit the calorie and protein targets, and mentions any meal waiting for review without counting it.

positive.description: Weekday vs weekend pattern over two months
positive.prompt: Over the last 60 days, do I eat more on weekends than on weekdays?
positive.expected_behavior: Compares average calories per logged day by weekday. The demo account shows roughly 1,700 kcal on weekdays and clearly more on Saturday and Sunday (about 2,500 to 2,800 kcal), in the America/New_York timezone saved on the account.

positive.prompt: Where does most of my protein come from over the last two months?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the foods that contribute most protein with totals and share of the total, led by grilled chicken breast, roasted chicken thighs and Greek yogurt in the demo account.

positive.description: Raw meal list for a week
positive.prompt: Show every meal I logged from 20 to 26 October 2026 as a table with time, meal and calories.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a table of that week's meals with local times in America/New_York, meal type, description and calories, matching what the Know My Meals app shows.

positive.prompt: What are my daily targets and goal in Know My Meals?
positive.expected_behavior: States the daily calorie, protein, carb and fat targets, the goal (lose weight at a weekly rate) and dietary style from the account, without inventing values that are null.

negative.prompt: Log a banana for breakfast today in Know My Meals.
Give me my nutrition summary from 1 January 2025 to 30 October 2026 in one request.
What's the weather in New York tomorrow?

review.commerce_description: The plugin doesn't sell anything or link to checkout. A user without an active Know My Meals plan gets a plain 'plan isn't active' message.

publication.release_notes: First release: six read-only tools for nutrition summaries, eating patterns, top foods, today's intake, the meal list, and goals.
